description: This source file defines GUI-related functions for handling converters in the BORIS behavioral observation software. It includes functions for adding, modifying, deleting, saving, and loading converter functions, as well as generating dynamic Python functions from user input code. The code interacts with GUI elements such as text fields, buttons, and tables, and references other modules like dialog and config.

methods.name: pb_code_help_clicked(self)
methods.description: Displays an informational message box explaining how to write converters.

methods.name: add_converter(self)
methods.description: Enables input fields for adding a new converter and disables other UI controls.

methods.name: modify_converter(self)
methods.description: Populates input fields with selected converter data for editing and toggles UI controls accordingly.

methods.name: code_2_func(self, name: str, code: str)
methods.description: Converts GUI input code into a Python function as a string with a specified name.

methods.name: save_converter(self)
methods.description: Validates, compiles, and saves the converter code and info into the GUI table.

methods.name: cancel_converter(self)
methods.description: Cancels the editing or creation of a converter, resetting input fields and UI controls.

methods.name: delete_converter(self)
methods.description: Deletes the selected converter from the GUI table after user confirmation.

methods.name: load_converters_from_file_repo(self, mode: str)
methods.description: Loads converters from a JSON file or remote repository, allowing user to import them into the GUI.
